_note: Layer-3 outputs for the probe set in data/eval-set.json, produced by running prompts/extraction-prompt.md against each probe's documents. Scored by scripts/evaluate.py.
_provenance: Generated by a language model reading the probe documents under the production prompt. Outputs are recorded as produced, including the three that are wrong. They are not hand-authored to a target score.
_evaluationAwarenessCaveat: A known limitation of this method: the model producing these outputs knows it is being evaluated on an adversarial set, which plausibly makes it more careful than it would be on case 400 of a Tuesday queue. Treat these as an optimistic bound on live behaviour, and treat a real shadow-mode run as the number that counts.

findings.quote: Patient has not responded to conservative management and continues to report symptoms limiting activities of daily living.
findings.relevance: The treating therapist states directly that the patient did not respond to conservative management, which is the condition the claims ledger cannot establish.
Objective corroboration of limited response across the episode.

findings.quote: Patient completed an eight-week course of skilled physical therapy without meaningful improvement in pain or function. Symptoms have not responded to conservative management including therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and an independent home exercise program.
findings.relevance: Documents a completed course of conservative management to which the patient did not respond.
findings.concerns: The same discharge summary gives the treating diagnosis as rotator cuff tear, right shoulder. Whether this episode constitutes conservative management directed at the lumbar complaint is a clinical judgment and appears doubtful.

EV-002.modelSelfAssessment: Rule 4 of the prompt directs that a treatment episode for a different body region does not satisfy a criterion about this complaint, and should not be reported. The concern field surfaced the right doubt; reporting it anyway is the error. Same failure as hero case PA-2026-115003.

findings.quote: Symptoms have not responded to conservative management to date.
findings.relevance: The therapist records that the patient did not respond to the conservative management undertaken.
findings.concerns: The episode spans 08/04/2026 to 08/17/2026, which is under the four-week duration the criterion requires. The non-response finding stands on its own terms but the trial may not meet the duration condition.

EV-006.modelSelfAssessment: A scoring-boundary case rather than a clean error. The model was asked only about the non-response condition (C2b) and answered it truthfully; the duration failure belongs to C2a, which the claims layer resolved as unsatisfied. The finding is correct about its own condition and misleading about the criterion as a whole. See the note on per-condition scoring in scripts/evaluate.py.

findings.quote: Patient completed a six-week course of skilled physical therapy directed at the lumbar spine without meaningful improvement. Symptoms have not responded to conservative management.
findings.relevance: A completed six-week lumbar therapy course with documented non-response, directly addressing the criterion.

EV-007.modelSelfAssessment: The page belongs to a different member — a different name, date of birth and member ID appear in the same passage the quote was taken from. The model read the clinical content and did not check identity. Worse than the region error because nothing was flagged: concerns is null, so the finding arrives looking clean.

findings.quote: Symptoms have not responded to conservative management. Goals 0 of 3 met.
findings.relevance: The progress note records non-response to a seven-week lumbar therapy course.
findings.concerns: The note is handwritten and abbreviated; the scan quality is poor.

EV-008.modelSelfAssessment: The model located the right evidence and then tidied it. The source reads 'Sympt have not resp to conserv mgmt. Goals 0/3 met.' and the quote expands the abbreviations into well-formed prose. The citation guard will discard this finding for quote drift — correctly, since it is not what the document says. The net effect is a false negative produced by the guard working as designed.
